name: Jade Weideman
description: Jade Weideman’s PLACE19 abstract proposed a freshwater-sampling example showing ArcGIS Online browser and field workflows. The programme identifies him as an Esri technical consultant at Geographic Business Solutions supporting geospatial project implementation.
